methodology.id_presence_is_not_quality: A protocol is not complete merely because its ID appears in a document.
methodology.generic_boilerplate_detection: Batch 04 repeats identical generic setup/acquisition/dose/failure/retention/safety wording across records; skill-specific assessment prompts do not cure generic procedural content.
methodology.status_rule: All candidates remain draft and require substantive skill-specific rewrite plus appropriate review.
methodology.substantive_draft_definition: A skill-specific sequence, dose, assessment, failure modes, delayed retention, transfer and safety scope are explicitly authored. These remain drafts pending review.
